explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that covers this theorem in its stated generality. The closest is `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map_scalar` in Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/Defs.lean: `map f (scalar n u) = scalar n (Units.map f u)`. That lemma is about Mathlib's `GeneralLinearGroup.map`, which is only defined when `R` and `S` are `CommRing`s. The theorem here is about the library's own `mapRingHom` (Whitehead.lean, line 31). It has the same definition as Mathlib's `map`, `Units.map f.mapMatrix.toMonoidHom`, but it only assumes `Semiring R` and `Semiring S`. Mathlib's lemma therefore needs stronger hypotheses and does not apply in the theorem's setting; in fact Mathlib's `map_scalar` is the commutative-ring case of this theorem. I found no Mathlib version of `GeneralLinearGroup.map` or `map_scalar` stated over semirings. I searched the `scalar` and `map` lemmas in Mathlib's GeneralLinearGroup directory.
